meta.name: game-art-direction
meta.description: Direct game art and creative vision. Turn GAME_DESIGN into a production-level ART_DIRECTION defining a recognizable visual style, camera and composition, world and character grammar, functional colour/light/material, HUD feedback, motion and transition specs, audio direction, and a signature moment for every screen and mode. Use for what should the game look like, set the art direction, define the visual style. 游戏美术与创意方向。把 GAME_DESIGN 转成策划级 ART_DIRECTION，定义可辨识视觉风格、镜头构图、世界与角色语法、功能性色光材质、界面反馈、运动与转场规格、声音方向和每个界面/模式的签名游戏时刻。用于判断游戏应该长什么样、制定游戏美术方向等需求。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制定游戏的整体视觉风格与美术语言
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要先定义游戏的视觉风格与美术基调。
copy.tagline_en: Define your game's visual style and art direction before production.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to establish a clear visual language for your game before starting development.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会基于已有的游戏设计与产品简报,产出美术方向文档,明确视觉风格、镜头构图、角色/世界语法、功能性色光材质、界面反馈、动效转场、声音方向与各界面招牌时刻。
howto.when: 当你说“游戏应该长什么样”“制定美术方向”“定义视觉风格”等,且已有 GAME_DESIGN 和 PRODUCT_BRIEF 文件时触发。

say.text: 根据我的 GAME_DESIGN,制定这套游戏的美术方向。
帮我把第一关的镜头语法和角色轮廓定义出来。
say.note: 补充具体视觉语法规则。

say.text: 给每个界面设计一个招牌时刻。
say.note: 逐屏描述玩家动作与界面反馈。

howto.what_en: Turns game design and product brief into an art direction document: visual style, camera/composition, character/world grammar, functional color/light/material, HUD feedback, motion/transitions, audio direction, signature moments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask what the game should look like, set art direction, or define visual style, and GAME_DESIGN/PRODUCT_BRIEF files already exist.

say_en.text: Based on my GAME_DESIGN, define the art direction for this game.
Define the camera grammar and character silhouettes for level one.
Design a signature moment for each screen.
say_en.note: Describes player actions and UI feedback per screen.
